knowledge.name: Synthetic pipeline snapshot
knowledge.detail: Bundled opportunity, stage, value, owner, activity-gap, champion, blocker, and rep-capacity evidence supports portable demos.

knowledge.name: Stage benchmarks and blocker playbooks
knowledge.detail: Healthy stage-duration benchmarks and blocker-specific diagnoses, actions, timing, and suggested resources drive deterministic analysis.

knowledge.name: Approved operating rules and skills
knowledge.detail: Two knowledge files and six operation skills define evidence use, response anchors, prohibited actions, and approval gates.

intelligence_processing.name: Pipeline health classification
intelligence_processing.detail: Classifies active opportunities as on track, at risk, or stalled and summarizes value, stage age, and root causes.

intelligence_processing.name: Stalled-deal diagnosis
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares stage age with benchmarks and explains momentum loss from engagement, champion, and blocker evidence.

intelligence_processing.name: Draft intervention planning
intelligence_processing.detail: Builds reviewable week-by-week actions, candidate owners, timing, planning objectives, and suggested resources.

intelligence_processing.name: Acceleration scenario comparison
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares pull-forward options and quick wins while labeling all timing and value projections as synthetic scenarios.

intelligence_processing.name: Capacity-aware task mapping
intelligence_processing.detail: Maps candidate follow-up work against synthetic rep capacity without creating assignments, alerts, or workflows.

intelligence_processing.name: Leadership synthesis
intelligence_processing.detail: Condenses pipeline findings, root causes, draft actions, and synthetic planning targets for human review.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot conversational review
clients_user_interface.detail: Copilot Studio provides the natural-language surface for selecting one of six bounded review operations.

clients_user_interface.name: Account executive workspace
clients_user_interface.detail: Account executives can inspect stalled-deal evidence and draft intervention plans before any customer or CRM action.

clients_user_interface.name: Sales director workspace
clients_user_interface.detail: Sales directors review pipeline health, acceleration scenarios, candidate task mappings, and leadership summaries.

management_reporting.name: Pipeline Health Summary
management_reporting.detail: Reports active pipeline value, status distribution, stage-age measures, critical stalled deals, and root causes.

management_reporting.name: Stalled Deal Deep-Dive
management_reporting.detail: Reports deal-level stage, benchmark variance, last contact, champion status, blocker, and diagnosis evidence.

management_reporting.name: Draft Task Assignment Plan
management_reporting.detail: Reports candidate tasks, rep capacity, deadlines, monitoring ideas, and accountability cadence for manager review.

management_reporting.name: Executive Summary
management_reporting.detail: Reports pipeline findings, immediate review priorities, process ideas, and explicitly synthetic planning targets.

tools.name: Portable DealProgressionAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: A single Python BasicAgent exposes six deterministic operations and runs locally with bundled synthetic evidence.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the conversational agent, uploaded knowledge, operation skills, and draft-before-publish authoring workflow.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 Sales
tools.detail: Approved production connection seam for opportunity and activity context; the packaged route remains synthetic and read-only.

tools.name: SharePoint
tools.detail: Approved production connection seam for sales playbooks; current package uses uploaded synthetic knowledge files.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.detail: Supports manager-led follow-up after review; the agent does not send messages, alerts, assignments, or customer outreach.

tools.name: Foundation model selected by deployment environment
tools.detail: The deployment environment supplies the model used to interpret requests and present bounded tool results.

supporting_features.name: Explicit operation routing
supporting_features.detail: A fixed enum dispatches pipeline health, stalled deals, action plans, acceleration, task mapping, or executive summary.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only source enforcement
supporting_features.detail: The portable tool rejects non-synthetic data_source values and forbids browsing, enrichment, or invented records.

supporting_features.name: Read-only evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Every successful result states that no CRM write, task, alert, pricing approval, forecast change, or outreach occurred.

supporting_features.name: Human approval gates
supporting_features.detail: Authorized owners and leaders review tasks, deadlines, forecasts, and communications; specialist review remains mandatory where applicable.

supporting_features.name: Locked six-case validation
supporting_features.detail: One deterministic persona case per operation verifies routing, required evidence anchors, and prohibited side-effect claims.

supporting_features.name: Draft and publish separation
supporting_features.detail: Copilot Studio push and validation stop in Draft; publication and external actions require explicit user confirmation.
